notes.source: Last pregame snapshot of our sportsbook feed; results from ESPN box scores.
notes.timing: Prices come from the last snapshot we saved before each game, normally our late-afternoon refresh on game days (5 PM ET in daylight time, 4 PM in standard time). For the games graded so far that was a median of 3.5 hours before tipoff (range 0.1 to 12.9). Lines often move before tipoff, especially after injury reports and starting lineups, so this compares results with that snapshot, not the closing line.
notes.board_axis: Share of lines that went over (spread and moneyline: share the favorite covered or won)
notes.board_axis_short: Share over (game lines: favorite covered or won)
notes.empty: NBA results are not graded yet. They will appear here once the first games are final.
